evidence.quote: alr-20261019-0113 | 2026-10-19T06:00:00Z | volume_drop | Order volume for 2026-10-18 is 26% below the 7-day average (threshold 25%) | open | NULL
evidence.why: Alert triggered because the volume dropped by 26% compared to the 7-day average.
Actual ingested row count for 2026-10-18 (Sunday) was 2102, consistent with weekend volume patterns (e.g. Saturday 2026-10-17 had 2120).
Shows that weekends (dow 6 and 0) naturally experience lower order volumes (~2100 vs ~2900-3000), causing a naive 7-day trailing average comparison to trigger a false positive volume drop alert.

next_checks: Consider updating the volume alert rule to account for day-of-week seasonality rather than a simple 7-day trailing average.
args.root_cause: The volume drop alert was a false positive caused by comparing Sunday's naturally lower order volume against a 7-day trailing average that included higher weekday volumes. The pipeline and data ingestion functioned correctly with zero data loss.
args.suggested_fix: Adjust the alert threshold or baseline calculation to compare against same-day-of-week averages (or weekend-adjusted averages) rather than a flat 7-day moving average.
